high_level_description: This image is an advertisement for a pop-up event by Capsul. The background is a solid olive-green color, giving the image a modern and sleek look. The central figure in the image is a person standing confidently with their hands in their pockets. They are wearing a vibrant, graphic T-shirt featuring a blue and orange design with abstract shapes and a figure that appears to be dancing or moving dynamically. The T-shirt has long sleeves underneath, which are rolled up to the elbows, adding to the casual yet stylish vibe.
